config.dire_difficulty.title: Dire Difficulty
How hard it gets follows the world difficulty. The game starts close to vanilla and grows harder as you complete advancements, kill monsters, travel and stay alive. Easy stops at a quarter of the way, Normal at half, Hard goes all the way.
config.dire_difficulty.spawnElites.toolt: Some monsters spawn as elites: bigger, stronger, with special abilities and better loot.
config.dire_difficulty.modifySpawns.tool: Let progression raise how often monsters spawn, how many there can be, and how far away they stay before despawning. Off keeps vanilla spawning. The settings on the Spawning tab only apply while this is on.
config.dire_difficulty.theHunt.tooltip: Monsters notice you from much farther away.
config.dire_difficulty.elitePlate.toolti: Show an elite's name, health and abilities at the top of the screen while you look at it.
config.dire_difficulty.eliteGearDrops.to: Let an elite's armour and weapon drop when it dies, like any monster's gear: rarely and damaged.
config.dire_difficulty.eliteGlow.tooltip: Elites glow in their rarity colour and light up the ground around them.
config.dire_difficulty.daySpawning.toolt: Monsters can spawn in daylight. They still need open sky, so a lit base stays safe.
config.dire_difficulty.daySpawnBurnImmun: Monsters don't burn in sunlight while daylight spawning is on.
config.dire_difficulty.spawnFrequencyAtM: How often monsters spawn once you are fully progressed, as a multiplier. 1.0 is vanilla. Rises gradually from vanilla as you progress.
config.dire_difficulty.mobCapAtMax.toolt: How many monsters the world can hold once you are fully progressed, as a multiplier. 1.0 is vanilla.
config.dire_difficulty.despawnDistanceAt: How far monsters can be from you before they despawn once you are fully progressed, as a multiplier. 1.0 is vanilla.
